doc: Live-coded melody: a Clock drives a `pattern` Operator that plays the `pattern` pipe's mini-notation text as scale degrees through an 8-voice Voicer, so it opens playing a default tune. Send new text to /pattern/in through the engine channel's `send` (the one path that compiles it; a compile error comes back in the reply) and it takes over at the next cycle of 4 beats. `tempo` sets the Clock; `key` (MIDI tonic) the scale the degrees resolve against.

nodes.doc: The beat grid the pattern plays against: `phase` and `beat` together are the musical position.
Plays the `pattern` pipe's text, one cycle per 4 beats, as scale-degree notes. A new pattern starts at the next cycle; the old one plays out its cycle first.
The tonal context the voicer resolves the pattern's degrees against: the `key` pipe sets the tonic, default C major.
Hosts 8 default-voice sub-patches; resolves the pattern's degrees through /harmony, allocates them across the voices and sums their audio.
